shortBio.en: Joy Division vocalist; baritone delivery and epilepsy-era stage intensity, 1976–80 only.
shortBio.zh: Joy Division 主唱；男中音吐字与癫痫时期舞台强度，仅 1976–80。

whyHub.en: Short tragic tenure that freezes the Joy Division catalog; surviving members become New Order without him.
whyHub.zh: 短暂悲剧任期冻结 Joy Division 目录；其余成员在无他的情况下成为 New Order。

body.en:
Born 1956. Fronts Joy Division with Sumner, Hook, Morris. Unknown Pleasures (1979) and Closer (1980) cite dry Martin Hannett production under Curtis’s baritone and lyric freeze-frames. Dies May 1980; band ends. Sumner/Hook/Morris form New Order.

Hub is negative space: the person page marks the cut between post-punk peak and the dance-leaning sequel.
body.zh:
1956 年生。与 Sumner、Hook、Morris 组成 Joy Division。Unknown Pleasures（1979）与 Closer（1980）引用 Martin Hannett 干制作，衬 Curtis 男中音与歌词定格。1980 年 5 月去世；乐队终止。Sumner/Hook/Morris 组建 New Order。

枢纽是负空间：人物页标出后朋克巅峰与偏舞续篇之间的切断。

note.en: Only tenure; ends with death before New Order.
note.zh: 唯一任期；去世于 New Order 之前。
